text: The purpose of this report is to advise the General Government and Licensing Committee of the Contracts valued over $20 million awarded in 2021 under the extended authority of the Bid Award Panel in accordance with the Section 195-8.3, A and B of the Municipal Code, Chapter 195, Purchasing.
The General Government and Licensing Committee received the report (September 16, 2021) from the Chief Procurement Officer for information.
